purpose: Second representation-only retrospective bridge from P0-S3A. Keep the exact historical rows, 40/20 roles, purely-local detector construction, step-max reducer, threshold objective, access tier and grouped bootstrap while replacing only raw token entropy with the calibration-only LOCAL_IU29 token-risk curve. The split and population bridges remain unopened.

fixed_factors.evaluation_role: historical deterministic 20 percent audit per family
fixed_factors.answer_detector_construction: maximum of the same token-risk curve used by the locator
fixed_factors.threshold_objective: historical calibration-role ProcessBench macro F1 within each scorer cell
fixed_factors.threshold_tie_break: first maximum in stable descending risk sweep
fixed_factors.scorer_copy_grouping: same source-question draw carries both scorer copies
fixed_factors.supervision: representation and fusion fit are label-free on calibration rows; labels enter only the unchanged historical threshold and metrics

iu29_contract.step_locator: token-risk argmax mapped to known step span

bootstrap_contract: Paired source-question bootstrap. A family-unit draw carries both scorer copies and both S3A/S3B predictions; family estimates are averaged before the four-family macro contrast.
hard_fail_conditions: any registered S3A source, artifact, dependency, runner or registry hash differs
any S3A unit, target, locator, prediction, score, threshold or metric fails reconstruction within 1e-12
the 1270-row, 635-source-question population or its grouping hash changes
any factor besides the local-risk representation changes
the IU29 transform or fusion reads any audit row during fitting
a label enters representation construction, orientation or fusion fitting
any input matrix differs from the frozen 29-stream SHARED_TOKEN_VIEWS order
the fitted token-risk curve is not used identically by the max detector and step-max locator
the split or population bridge is opened in the same run

mutation_boundary.method_fit: label-free mixed-v2 and LOCAL_IU29 fit on historical calibration rows only; historical labels remain confined to threshold selection and metrics
